text: I am writing to respectfully request the installation of an additional speed hump on Rostrevor Road, between Eglinton Ave West and Dewbourne Ave. While the street already has speed humps, residents continue to complain about speeding and other forms of reckless drive behavior as the existing speed humps seem to be far apart. Traffic Operations staff have identified an opportunity to install an additional speed hump to assist with the concerns.

The Toronto East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of additional traffic calming (speed hump) on Rostrevor Road, between Eglinton Avenue West and Dewbourne Avenue. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter a section of the roadway on Rostrevor Road, between Eglinton Avenue West and Dewbourne Avenue, to install one additional speed hump, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. TC-108' dated November 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
